The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

Tool usage guidance:
	1. For 'search_*' tools: Use separate 'sort' and 'order' parameters if available for sorting results - do not include 'sort:' syntax in query strings. Query strings should contain only search criteria (e.g., 'org:google language:python'), not sorting instructions.

### Launcher — `ChangeArrivalDeadlineDateDialog.java`

- Serializable `@ManagedBean(name = "changeArrivalDeadlineDateDialog") @SessionScoped`, mirroring `ChangeDestinationDialog`.
- `showDialog(String trackingId)` passes `trackingId` as a `Map<String, List<String>>` request parameter and opens `/admin/dialogs/changeArrivalDeadlineDate.xhtml` with the fixed options (modal `true`, draggable `true`, resizable `false`, content `410x280`).
- `handleReturn(SelectEvent)` is the caller-side hook Issue 5 will bind to `dialogReturn`.
- `cancel()` closes with `""` and never calls the facade; success closes with `"DONE"` from the editor bean.

### View — `changeArrivalDeadlineDate.xhtml`

- `<f:metadata>` sits directly under root `<html>`, before `<h:head>`, as this MyFaces/Open Liberty baseline requires for `UIViewRoot` metadata:

```xhtml
<html ...>
<f:metadata>
    <f:viewParam name="trackingId" value="#{changeArrivalDeadlineDate.trackingId}"/>
    <f:viewAction action="#{changeArrivalDeadlineDate.load}"/>
</f:metadata>
<h:head>
    <title>Change Deadline</title>
```

- Read-only `Origin:` / `Destination:` labels; required, labeled `p:datePicker` bound to `arrivalDeadlineDate` with a `p:message` for feedback. No minimum/future/itinerary date rules added.
- Cancel uses `process="@this"` so the required date does not block dismissal; Update reuses the destination dialog's caller-refresh, guarded by `args.validationFailed` so validation messages survive.

### Note for reviewers

Submitting either dialog *directly* (no `pf_dlgcid` parameter) raises an EL `NullPointerException` inside PrimeFaces `closeDynamic` after the mutation commits. This reproduces identically on the pre-existing `changeDestination.xhtml`, so it appears to be framework behavior outside the dialog lifecycle rather than something introduced here.

{"command":"set -e
REPO='edburns/dd-3061974-02-cargotracker'; PR=10; HEAD='639e6b4870cd3505ef1c887789f4a856f5009431'; PREVIOUS=0
TIMEOUT=${COPILOT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}; ELAPSED=0; COPILOT_REVIEW=''
while [ "$ELAPSED" -lt "$TIMEOUT" ]; do
  COPILOT_REVIEW=$(gh api "/repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR/reviews" 2>/dev/null | jq --arg head "$HEAD" --argjson previous "$PREVIOUS" '[.[] | select((.user.login // "") | test("^copilot-pull-request-reviewer(\\[bot\\])?$"; "i")) | select(.commit_id == $head) | select(.id > $previous)] | last // empty')
  [ -n "$COPILOT_REVIEW" ] && break
  sleep 30; ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + 30))
done
if [ -z "$COPILOT_REVIEW" ]; then echo "SHEPHERD FAILED: Copilot review did not complete within ${TIMEOUT}s for PR #$PR at $HEAD."; exit 1; fi
TOO_MANY=$(printf '%s' "$COPILOT_REVIEW" | jq 'select((.body // "") | test("wasn.t able to review"; "i")) | select((.body // "") | test("maximum number of files"; "i"))')
if [ -n "$TOO_MANY" ]; then echo "SHEPHERD FAILED: Copilot could not review PR #$PR because it exceeds the maximum number of files."; exit 2; fi
RID=$(printf '%s' "$COPILOT_REVIEW" | jq -r '.id')
printf 'COPILOT_REVIEW_ID=%s\n' "$RID"
gh api "/repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR/comments" | jq --argjson review_id "$RID" '[.[] | select(.pull_request_review_id == $review_id) | select(.in_reply_to_id == null) | {id, path, line, body}]'
